all effect and target-flag applicability cases through the 65-entry effect dispatch
dead-unit, healing, cure, modifier, and status eligibility rules
the compacted eligible target list and -2/-1 empty-list results

the one-, two-, three-, and four-target weighted random selections and the uniform fallback

source texture around the effect jump-table tails and shared branches

rejected_experiments: seven-element local arrays produced a 96-byte frame; six-element arrays plus declaration ordering recover the exact 92-byte frame and all three reference array bases

notes: This is a complete semantic candidate, not a partial m2c transcription. Retained assembly remains authoritative and the draft claims zero DONE bytes.

No broad permanent classification or bounded permutation search is justified at this residual.

Recovered only from retained owner assembly, approved local GS1 ROM correspondence, repository battle types and callers, and the approved compiler. No external source, history, copied instruction bytes, inline assembly, fixed-register variable, compiler barrier, or compiler modification was used.
